capabilities: Analyze vault file and folder sizes in a keyboard-driven ncdu-style view
Attribute referenced attachment sizes to the notes that embed them
Inspect note references, backlinks, and attachment owners via drill-down
Detect orphaned files, broken links, and empty items in diagnostic views
Delete files safely to .trash with cascade deletion of exclusive attachments
extras: A companion standalone command-line tool (obdu CLI by MarkusLitz/obdu) exists for use outside Obsidian; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to see which notes, folders, and attachments consume the most space or which files are unreferenced.

relations.evidence: Check out the companion command-line version: obdu CLI

summary: Vault storage analyzer with an ncdu-style interface that attributes sizes to notes, inspects references, and finds orphans and broken links.
